## 路由:`domain:engine`(⛔ **不是** `domain:services`)· `bug` · **p2** · `pm:queue`

由 `domain:services` PM 席(座位贴 #6021)在 #13714 的落地窗口分诊。**落点 `packages/drivers/turso/**` ⇒ 车道表 `domain:engine` 行**(`packages/drivers/driver-*` 于 2026-08-19 并入 engine,原 `domain:drivers` 标签退役)。⇒ **不归本席派发**,交 `domain:engine` 车道。

## p2 的理由

- **不是 p1**:落点是 Turso 远程数据源。⛔ 未确认有部署在 Turso 上跑 analytics cube;敞口未量。
- **不是 p3**:后果是 **每一个** cube 查询在该数据源上抛**裸 `Error`、无 code、无 status** ⇒ 不只是坏,而且**不可分诊** —— 调用方拿不到能路由的错误面。这比 #13714 原症状(至少是 `DATABASE_ERROR`/500)更难查。

## ⭐ 与 #13714 的关系:同一类,不同面,⛔ 不可合卡

#13714 的根因是 **knex 的 `??` 绑定把别名当引用去解析**(按 `.` 切分),修法是让别名走 `client.wrapIdentifier` 成为**一个**标识符。

本卡是**同一个输入撞上另一道墙**:Turso 的 `RemoteTransport` 把聚合别名约束在 `SAFE_IDENTIFIER`(不许带点),于是 analytics 那个天生带点的 `<cube>.<measure>` 被**注入守卫**挡下。

⇒ ⚠️ **修法不同,所以必须分卡**:#13714 是「别名该被引号包成一个标识符」;本卡是「注入守卫该**转义引号字符**,而不是**拒绝点号**」。⛔ 把守卫放松成允许点号是错的方向 —— 那会削弱注入防护;要做的是让它按标识符转义规则处理,而不是按字符白名单拒绝。**这一判断需要该车道自己复核**,本席只做路由,⛔ 不代裁修法。

## 派发时的提醒

- ⚠️ **#13714 的修复(PR #14112)不会顺带修好本卡** —— 两处是独立的门。等 #14112 落地后,Turso 面仍会拒。
- 本卡的 dev 已做过重复扫描:436 张开卡、零命中 ⇒ 无重复。
- 建议验收形状照 #14112:证据要能分辨「别名位」与「列引用位」—— 守卫放松若波及列引用,那是把一个缺陷换成一个安全问题。

⭐ This card was filed by a seat that had the fix in hand for the sibling face and **deliberately did not patch it inline**, because the alias position needs a judgement the `field` position does not. That restraint is why this card is precise; honour it by not collapsing the two positions.

---

## Zone 1 — BINDING. ⛔ NOT re-adjudicable.

**1.1 — ⛔ Do NOT drop the check on the alias. Escape the quote character instead.** The card is explicit and correct: `alias` is interpolated **raw** into `AS "${alias}"`, so an alias containing a `"` breaks out of the quoting. Removing the guard trades a false refusal for an injection seam. The repair is: **let the alias be any string, and escape `"` → `""`** — the standard SQL doubled-quote escape inside a quoted identifier.

**1.2 — ⛔ The guard stays intact in the `field` position.** `SAFE_IDENTIFIER` is doing real work there. This card touches the **alias** position only. A diff that relaxes `field` has left the card.

**1.3 — Follow #13714's distinction, do not re-derive a different one.** That PR drew exactly this line one face over: a **qualified reference** (which must be validated) versus a **single output name** (which must be quoted and escaped). `AggregationNodeSchema` declares `alias: z.string()` — an output-column key, not a reference — and the in-memory, MongoDB and (post-#13714) SQL faces all project it verbatim. ⇒ **This face is the outlier, and the contract is what the other three already do.**

---

## Zone 2 — PM mechanism assumptions. ⚠️ MEASURE. Falsification welcome.

**2.1 — I assume the anchors have drifted.** The card cites `remote-transport.ts:71` for `SAFE_IDENTIFIER`. ⚠️ Re-derive it; the card was filed 2026-09-01 and `origin/main` has moved to `1403d943` since.

**2.2 — I assume this is confined to `packages/drivers/driver-turso`.** The card's scope note says local-file Turso mode inherits `SqlDriver` and is already covered by #13714, so only the remote transport's own hand-written SQL face is in play. ⚠️ **If your diff reaches `packages/drivers/driver-sql`, stop and report** — that would mean #13714's repair is incomplete, which is a different card.

**2.3 — I assume the un-bucketed path is the reproducing one.** The card says remote mode publishes `queryDateGranularity: {}`, so a *bucketed* query buckets in memory and never reaches `aggregate` — it is the **un-bucketed** cube query that eats the refusal. ⭐ Get your reproduction on the path that actually reaches `driver.aggregate`, or you will measure a green that means nothing.

**2.4 — I assume the error is currently un-enveloped, and that this is half the defect.** The card measures a bare `Error` with **no `code` and no `status`**, which `mapDataError` then serves as an opaque 500 — the #11455 / #8931 shape this repo has been closing door by door. ⚠️ **Measure whether your fix leaves any remaining refusal on this path un-enveloped.** If a genuinely unsafe alias can still reach the user as a bare 500 after your change, say so — closing the false refusal while leaving the true one opaque is only half the card.

---

## Zone 3 — advisory. ⛔ Not binding.

The doubled-quote escape is one line; the value is in the test that proves a dotted `CUBE.MEASURE` alias now survives end-to-end *and* that an alias containing a `"` is still handled safely rather than breaking the statement. Those two are the pair.

## STOP conditions

1. The repair reaches `packages/drivers/driver-sql` ⇒ report; that means #13714 is incomplete.
2. You conclude the guard must be relaxed rather than the alias escaped ⇒ that contradicts 1.1 ⇒ **stop and report your reading**, do not proceed on it.
3. Any other open PR has claimed `remote-transport.ts` since dispatch ⇒ report rather than racing. (Measured at dispatch against the 10 open PRs: none touches it. ⚠️ A file-overlap reading has a shelf life measured in merges — re-check before you push.)

## Verification expected

A test pinning both directions: a dotted `CUBE.MEASURE` alias reaching `aggregate` on the remote transport now succeeds, and an alias containing a `"` is escaped rather than breaking out. The `field` position still refusing what it refused before (that is your regression control). A firing positive control on any zero. Plus a changeset, push, and a DRAFT PR saying `Closes #14113`.

⛔ Report anything unmeasured as **NOT MEASURED**. ⛔ No test skipped, disabled, quarantined or re-baselined. ⛔ Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`. Worktree-first.

Clause-②: yes — widens the accept set of the remote-transport aggregation alias position (a dotted `CUBE.MEASURE` alias is now accepted and escaped rather than refused). Path limb: no.
